data.gender_notes: Mord is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Mord is recorded in name-lists as “Mighty or Short”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mord expresses “Mighty or Short”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mord total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: מורד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who acts in opposition to the law, to someone in authority; an insurgent, a rebel.

in_greek.name: μορδώς
in_greek.long_meaning: A person who rebels against authority or a cause; a mutineer, an insurgent.

in_latin.name: Mordus
in_latin.long_meaning: A person who rebels against authority or a cause; a mutineer, an insurgent.
